name: nyra
description: Nyra — Telegram AI bot on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:worker && npm run typecheck:web

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: REQUIRED — your Telegram bot token from @BotFather (format `123456789:AA...`). Get it: message @BotFather → /mybots → your bot → API Token.

TELEGRAM_SECRET.description: REQUIRED — random webhook secret token, also used as the X-Setup-Secret header for /setup. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Never reuse the bot token.

ADMIN_IDS.description: REQUIRED — numeric Telegram user ID(s) of the administrator(s), digits only (e.g. `123456789`), comma-separated for several. Find yours by sending any message to @userinfobot.

AI_API_KEY.description: REQUIRED — central OpenAI-compatible API key, stored as a server-side Cloudflare Worker secret. Never expose it to users or browser clients.

AI_MODEL.description: REQUIRED — one globally configured model identifier.

AI_BASE_URL.description: Optional — OpenAI-compatible API base URL; defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1.

AI_SUPPORTS_VISION.description: Optional — set to true only when the configured model and endpoint support image input.
